recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up core change is needed for FHIR-15777; FHIR-46082 should remain a separate later-change audit/fix concern if reconciled independently.
issue_request: FHIR-15777 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive, raised and applied for STU3, asking to define a standard terminology service API so terminology operations can be referenced from FHIRPath constraints.
initial_application: Jira comments cite svn revision 13922. Git commit 843247233eca86f26c8251f8a1c59d94c13d692f is the git-svn build@13922 import and added a Terminology Service API section to source/fhirpath.html with %terminologies operations for expand, lookup, validateVS, validateCS, subsumes, and translate.
additional_context: The current source/fhirpath.html page remains the active FHIRPath page linked from the specification documentation. Later changes retained the API while reorganizing the page for FHIRPath release 2. FHIR-46082 later refined the same section by adding %terminologies and %terminologies.at(url) to distinguish default and explicit terminology servers. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence evidence that changes the Jira/source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhirpath.html#txapi defines the terminology service API, links each function to the corresponding FHIR terminology operation, and reflects both the original FHIR-15777 intent and later compatible refinements.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue clarified which terminology server %terminologies uses and added %terminologies.at(url), refining but not replacing the FHIR-15777 API.
